question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The road which __is joining__ two villages is repaired by local authorities.
solution:
The correct answer is Option: **Joins**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so the correct answer should also be in the present tense.&
